Verse of the Day
And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
Joel 2:26
Quote of the Day
"In our families and other personal relationships, let us avoid what is harsh and hateful. Let us seek to be holy."
President Dallin H. Oaks | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
